passages.title: Store opening
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 71 through 73 refer to the following announcement.
W: Attention, shoppers. Welcome to the grand opening of Hartley's Home Store. To celebrate, we're offering twenty percent off all kitchen items until Sunday evening.
W: Our customer service desk, located near the main entrance, will gladly help with gift wrapping at no charge.
W: The first hundred customers today will also receive a free set of oven gloves. Thank you for shopping with us.

passages.title: Dental office message
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 74 through 76 refer to the following telephone message.
M: Hello, this message is for Ms. Rivera. This is Dr. Ahn's office calling to remind you of your appointment tomorrow, Thursday, at 10:30 in the morning.
M: Please arrive ten minutes early to update your insurance information. If you need to reschedule, call us at 555-0136 before five o'clock today.
M: Otherwise, we look forward to seeing you tomorrow.

passages.title: Traffic report
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 77 through 79 refer to the following radio broadcast.
W: Good morning, commuters. Here's your traffic update. Drivers on Route 9 are experiencing delays of up to forty minutes due to an overturned truck near exit 12.
W: Police recommend using Mill Road as an alternative. The Harbor Bridge is clear, and the subway is running on schedule.
W: Our next traffic report will be at eight fifteen.

passages.title: Museum tour
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 80 through 82 refer to the following tour introduction.
M: Welcome to the Maritime Museum. I'm Karen, and I'll be your guide today. Our tour will last about ninety minutes, and we'll begin with the ship models on the ground floor.
M: Please remember that photography is allowed, but flash is not permitted in the gallery. If you'd like to see the special exhibit on navigation, tickets are available at the gift shop.
M: Now, please follow me.

passages.title: New safety policy
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 83 through 85 refer to the following staff announcement.
M: Good afternoon, everyone. As of Monday, all employees must scan their ID badges when entering and leaving the building.
M: This new system will help us keep track of who is in the building in case of an emergency. Badge scanners are being installed at all entrances this week.
M: If your badge is not working, please visit the security office on the first floor before Friday.

passages.title: Product advertisement
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 86 through 88 refer to the following advertisement.
W: Tired of slow internet? Switch to FiberLink and enjoy speeds up to ten times faster than standard connections.
W: Sign up this month and get your first three months free, with no installation fee. Plans start at just thirty dollars a month.
W: Visit fiberlink.example or call 555-0188 today. Offer ends June thirtieth.

passages.title: Quarterly results
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 89 through 91 refer to the following talk at a meeting.
W: Thank you all for coming. I'm pleased to report that our revenue grew by twelve percent this quarter, mostly due to strong sales of our new line of kitchen appliances.
W: However, our shipping costs also rose, so we'll be looking for ways to reduce them. I've asked the logistics team to present options at next week's meeting.
W: Now, let's turn to the sales figures for each region.

passages.title: Gate change
passages.body:
DEPARTURES
Flight   Destination   Departs
301   Denver   2:55 P.M.
305   Chicago   3:20 P.M.
308   Miami   3:45 P.M.
312   Seattle   4:10 P.M.
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 92 through 94 refer to the following airport announcement.
M: Attention, passengers on Flight 305 to Chicago. Due to a gate change, your flight will now depart from Gate D4 instead of Gate B7.
M: Boarding will begin at two forty-five. Passengers with seats in rows twenty to thirty will board first.
M: Please have your boarding pass and identification ready. We apologize for any inconvenience.

passages.title: Weather forecast
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 95 through 97 refer to the following weather report.
M: Good evening. Tomorrow will start with sunshine across the region, but clouds will move in by noon. Expect temperatures near twenty-five degrees in the afternoon.
M: A cold front will bring heavy rain on Thursday, along with strong winds along the coast. Residents near the river should be prepared for possible flooding.
M: Stay tuned for updates.

passages.title: Workshop introduction
passages.body:
TIME MANAGEMENT WORKSHOP — AGENDA
9:00   Goal setting
10:15   Break
10:30   Planning tools
12:00   Lunch
1:30   Group practice
4:00   Feedback and closing
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 98 through 100 refer to the following talk.
M: Good morning and welcome to the Time Management Workshop. I'm Dr. Alvarez. Today's session is divided into four parts.
M: We'll begin with goal setting, then take a short break before moving on to planning tools. After lunch, you'll practice in small groups.
M: Please turn off your phones during the sessions, and use the feedback forms on your tables at the end of the day.

passages.title: Late order message
passages.body:
ORDER 6623 — Delta Furniture
Desk, oak   Out of stock until the 20th
Desk, walnut   In stock
Desk, white   Discontinued
Chair, black   In stock
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 71 through 73 refer to the following voice mail message.
M: Hello, this is Sam from Delta Furniture, calling for Ms. Clarke. I'm calling about your desk order, number 6623.
M: Unfortunately, the oak model is out of stock until the twentieth. We can ship the walnut version immediately at the same price, or we can wait and deliver the oak one with free assembly.
M: Please call me back at 555-0172 by noon so that I can update your order.

passages.title: Restaurant promotion
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 74 through 76 refer to the following advertisement.
M: Looking for the perfect place for a family dinner? Join us at Bella Vista this month for our new tasting menu, featuring dishes from five regions of Italy.
M: On Tuesdays, kids eat free with every adult entrée. Reservations are recommended on weekends, and you can book online.
M: Bella Vista, on Lake Street, serving the community for twenty years.

passages.title: Conference welcome
passages.body:
CONFERENCE PROGRAM — Day 1
1:00   Opening address (Main Hall)
1:30   Keynote: Sustainable shipping (Main Hall)
3:00   Warehouse automation (Room 4)
4:30   Panel discussion (Main Hall)
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 77 through 79 refer to the following welcome speech.
M: Welcome to the Annual Logistics Conference. We have an exciting program prepared for you over the next two days.
M: This afternoon's keynote address will be delivered by Mr. Fernandez, who will talk about sustainable shipping. The session on warehouse automation, originally scheduled for three o'clock, has been moved to the Lakeview Room.
M: Please check your conference program for the updated room information, and enjoy the conference.

passages.title: Fitness club advertisement
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 80 through 82 refer to the following advertisement.
M: Ready to get fit? FlexZone Fitness is now open on Maple Avenue. With over a hundred machines, a heated pool and classes from yoga to boxing, there's something for everyone.
M: Join before March first and pay no membership fee. Every new member also receives two free sessions with a personal trainer.
M: Open daily from five in the morning until midnight.

passages.title: Building maintenance
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 83 through 85 refer to the following announcement.
M: May I have your attention, please. This is a message from the building manager. The elevators in the east wing will be out of service tomorrow from eight to noon for routine maintenance.
M: Please use the west wing elevators or the stairs during this time. Employees with mobility needs may arrange assistance by calling the front desk today.
M: We apologize for the inconvenience.

passages.title: Podcast introduction
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 86 through 88 refer to the following podcast introduction.
M: Welcome to Career Corner, the podcast for professionals who want to grow. I'm your host, Julia Park. Today we'll talk about the biggest mistakes people make in job interviews.
M: My guest is Mark Evans, a recruiter with more than fifteen years of experience. Later in the show, we'll answer questions from listeners.
M: If you'd like your question to be featured, send an email to the address on our website.

passages.title: Bank recorded message
passages.body:
UNION TRUST BANK — BRANCH HOURS
Westbrook   Mon–Fri 9:00–5:00   Sat 9:00–1:00
Downtown   Mon–Fri 8:30–6:00   Sat closed
Airport   Daily 7:00–9:00
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 89 through 91 refer to the following recorded message.
W: Thank you for calling Union Trust Bank. Our Westbrook branch is open Monday through Friday from nine to five, and on Saturday from nine to one.
W: Please note that on public holidays, all branches will be closed. For account balance information, press one. To speak with a customer service representative, press two.
W: You may also use our mobile app to deposit checks at any time.

passages.title: Award speech
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 92 through 94 refer to the following speech.
W: Good evening, everyone. It's my great honor to present this year's Employee of the Year award to Daniela Moretti. Daniela joined our customer service team just three years ago.
W: Since then, she has trained more than thirty colleagues and increased our customer satisfaction scores by twenty percent.
W: Daniela, please come up to receive your award and say a few words.
